recipe.title: Air Fryer Mini Meatloaves with Ketchup Glaze, Smashed Potatoes & Charred Broccoli
recipe.description: Two little meatloaves that come out of the air fryer with dark, sticky tangy-glazed tops and a juicy middle, next to craggy smashed baby potatoes and broccoli charred until the edges are almost black and finished with garlic and lime.

ingredients.item: White onion, grated on the coarse side of a box grater

ingredients.amount: 15 g total (10 g for the meatloaf, 5 g for the broccoli)
1 1/2 tsp total (1 tsp for the meat, 1/2 tsp for the glaze)

ingredients.item: Baby potatoes (The Little Potato Co.), any larger than a golf ball halved
Broccoli (new buy), cut into flat-sided florets about 4 cm

ingredients.amount: 22 g total (14 g for the potatoes, 8 g for the broccoli)

steps.title: Boil the potatoes
steps.content: Put the baby potatoes in a pot, cover with cold water, add a good pinch of salt and bring to a boil on high. Drop to a simmer (3-4 on the dial) and cook 15 minutes, until a fork slides in with no resistance. Drain and leave them in the colander to steam dry.

steps.title: Mix the raw meatloaf
steps.content: While the potatoes boil, in a bowl combine the grated onion, panko, egg, 10 g of the minced garlic, the Italian seasoning, 1 tsp paprika, the onion powder, salt and pepper. Add the RAW ground beef and mix with your hands just until it holds together — stop as soon as it comes together or the loaves turn dense.

steps.title: Shape the loaves
steps.content: Divide the raw mixture in two and shape each half into a compact loaf about 10 cm long and 4 cm tall. Press the tops flat-ish so the glaze has somewhere to sit.

steps.title: Air fry the meatloaves
steps.content: Preheat the air fryer to 190C/380F. Set both raw loaves in the basket with space between them — they go in raw and cook through in there. Air fry 15 minutes.

steps.title: Smash and season the potatoes
steps.content: While the loaves cook, lay the drained potatoes on the Tovala tray and press each one flat with the bottom of a glass until it cracks open, about 1.5 cm thick. Drizzle over 14 g olive oil, sprinkle with the garlic salt and pepper, and turn them gently so the craggy edges are coated. Keep them in a single layer — batch if the tray is crowded.

steps.title: Potatoes into the Tovala
steps.content: Run the Tovala on Air Fry at 200C/400F for 12 minutes, until the edges are deep brown and brittle. When it beeps, leave them inside with the door shut to stay hot.

steps.title: Mix the glaze and finish the meatloaves
steps.content: Stir the ketchup, red wine vinegar and 1/2 tsp paprika together. At the 15-minute mark, spoon the glaze thickly over the tops of the meatloaves, bump the air fryer to 200C/400F and cook 6 more minutes, until the glaze is dark and tacky at the edges.

steps.title: Char the broccoli
steps.content: As the glaze goes on, set a large skillet or the griddle over high heat for 2 minutes. Add 8 g olive oil and the broccoli florets, cut sides down, and leave them completely alone for 4 minutes to take a hard char. Toss and cook 3 more minutes, then add the remaining 5 g garlic, salt and pepper and toss for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Rest, acid, plate
steps.content: Pull the meatloaves out and let them rest 5 minutes — cutting straight away spills the juice. Off the heat, squeeze the half lime over the broccoli and toss. Plate a meatloaf per person with the smashed potatoes and broccoli alongside.

recipe.notes: Per serving: ~40 g protein, ~590 calories, ~5 g saturated fat, under 1 g added sugar, ~9 g fiber. New buys: 93% lean ground beef, whole wheat panko, broccoli — everything else is pantry. Fatty liver: this is the classic meatloaf dinner lightened in three places — 93% lean beef instead of chuck, whole wheat panko instead of white bread and milk, and the brown-sugar glaze rebuilt as no-sugar-added ketchup sharpened with red wine vinegar and paprika, so the top still goes dark and sticky with essentially no added sugar. Nothing is fried; the crust comes from the air fryer and the char comes from a dry hot pan. Pro tips: grate the onion rather than chop it — it melts in and keeps the lean beef juicy; don't move the broccoli for that first 4 minutes, the black edges are the point; press the potatoes until they actually crack, the broken edges are what crisp. Leftovers: meatloaf keeps 3 days and reheats best in the Tovala on Steam 4 minutes then Broil Hi 2 minutes — it comes back juicy instead of rubbery. Reheat the potatoes on Air Fry 5 minutes at 200C/400F; the broccoli is best eaten the night of.
